Singapore Travel update today | NO MORE VACCINATED TRAVEL LANES | COMPLETE REQUIREMENTS

SUBSCRIBE

Hello and welcome to my channel thewanderingman abroad- In this video, we are going to talk about the Vaccinated Travel Framework that is replacing Singapore VTL. That means no restrictions. This is now Also applicable to Pakistan & Bangladesh. In this video, we are going to discuss the complete process to travel to Singapore in 2022.

Read here DATED March 24,2022
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/singapore-reopen-borders-all-fully-vaccinated-travellers-apr-1-existing-vtls-will-be-retired-2582986

MAKE MY TRIP: https://visa.makemytrip.com/singapore-visa.html
MUSAFIR: https://in.musafir.com/Visa/Singapore-Visa.aspx

2. Insurance: ($ SGD 30000 required)
CHUBB: https://tinyurl.com/mrcac39h

AIG SINGAPORE: https://tinyurl.com/2ptj6cmc
TATA AIG: https://www.tataaig.com/buy-online/travel-insurance/
ICICI LOMBARD: https://www.icicilombard.com/travel-insurance/

3. SG ARRIVAL CARD: https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/sgarrivalcard/

4. IF YOU WERE COVID INFECTED (Check eligibility): 
    https://www.checkfirst.gov.sg/c/7f36b15e-3d3d-4b95-a904-7a5de6c6ddfb
    Read more about Recovered travelers: https://safetravel.ica.gov.sg/vaccinated-recovered

NOTE: Medical discharge memo issued by the relevant state authority or licensed medical professional; OR Result of a positive COVID-19 Polymerase Chain Reaction Test (PCR Test) administered at an internationally accredited or recognized lab/clinic/medical facility; OR
Result of a positive Antigen Rapid Test (ART) administered by a trained professional

5. MINISTRY OF MANPOWER APPROVAL (For work pass holders)
 https://www.mom.gov.sg/covid-19/entry-approval-requirements

6. VISA REQUIREMENTS
1. Original Passport with at least 6 months validity and minimum 3 blank pages + all old passports if any;
2. Visa Application form;
3. 2 recent color photographs (Photo Specification);
4. Personal Covering letter (For Employed - Plain paper/ For Self-Employed – Company Letterhead);
5. Original updated Bank Statement (last 6 months);
6. Confirmed return flight tickets;
7. Hotel reservation.

7. DOWNLOAD TRACE TOGETHER APP: https://www.tracetogether.gov.sg/

8. READ ALL REQUIREMENTS HERE; https://safetravel.ica.gov.sg/arriving/general-travel/fully-vaccinated

Check here: https://safetravel.ica.gov.sg/arriving/general-travel/fully-vaccinated
it states " Upon clearance, an e-Pass (i.e. Visit Pass) stating the period of stay granted will be issued to foreign short-term visit pass travellers via the email address indicated in the SGAC. Passports will no longer be stamped."

That's what I also showed on the screen too in the video.

If you do not fill SG Arrival card you have to walk up to the immigration officer and submit your docs and he will register you on the trace together app. The whole idea  is to avoid contacts with people and physical docs.

You travel history to Singapore would be your EPASS. That's it.
